text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I pass by the outdoor stage one day,
I spot
Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I figured no one would be using the
place at this
time of day, but I guess I
was wrong. What's with
the mountain of
boxes?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
They're filled with new yoga mats and
stuff... Huh,
good quality, too. Why are
they all wrapped up,
though? These
prizes for something?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, Taishin! You here to help pack
up, too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We're cleaning up the stage after the
event the
other day. Y'know, like
packing up the set and
prizes.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Prez and the others needed some extra
hands, so
that's why we're here!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
We get to keep any leftover prizes once
we're
done! It's treasure huntin' time!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Count me in. I'll help.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I decide to pitch in, and
everyone starts
taking down the set. We
seem to be making
pretty good
headway, but...
choice_data_list: Alright then, I'll help out too.
Alright then, I'll help out too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew. There's no end to this! How many
more
boxes do I have to lug around?! No
one told me
it'd be this much work!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I underestimated how long this would
take...
Why'd they even build such a
massive set?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whoooaaa! Comin' through! Outta the
way!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Hey, look ou—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: CRASHHH!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... We're finally done.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Sure, we kinda banged things up a bit,
but we still
got the job done!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You said it. Anyway, I'm gonna take this
yoga mat
and—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Actually... Sorry to burst your bubble,
but we're
not done yet. Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but there's still more stuff
backstage! I
really wanted to help Prez
out as much as
possible, so I told her
we'd take care of it all!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Are you for real? I'm already exhausted
as is.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Siiigh... Damn it. Let's just get this over with.
choice_data_list: I'll help you until the end.
Let's think of a more efficient way.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Pant... Turbo... boo...oost...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You look like you're gonna boost
yourself flat on
your face. No clue how
to conserve your energy,
huh? Go rest
for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... O-okay. I'll just take a teeny
break!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Teio, be more careful when dismantling
the set.
Unless you want it to fall apart
and crush you.
Your funeral.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you've got a point. Thanks,
Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Phew... If this isn't the definition of hard
labor, I
dunno what is.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm not doing this out of the kindness of
my heart.
I'm only here for the reward.
choice_data_list: Still, you're sticking with them to the end, huh?
Still, you're sticking with them to the end, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Enough talk. Get to work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It takes a while, but Narita Taishin
manages to
finish tidying everything up
and gets her
well-earned reward.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You can only be so efficient. Do you
realize how
long it took just to get this
spot done?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I continue the game metaphor and tell
her to
decide where to position her
party members.
choice_data_list: Let's think of it like a quest in a video game.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh. A quest, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I guess you'd be an engineer, Teio, since
you're
dexterous. You handle the
delicate work, like
dismantling the set
and storing any hardware.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
As for Turbo... You're agile, so kind of
like a foot
soldier, I guess. I want you to
focus on carrying
things.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...You're a villager.
choice_data_list: By the way, what about me?
By the way, what about me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
And as a villager, you get the fun task of
doing all
of the menial odd jobs. Now
get to work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We manage to get the job done by
following
Narita Taishin's instructions,
and she receives her
well-earned yoga
mat.
